answer: Pick the smallest thing that works. Bind each identity to one hardware key. Sign every submission with it. When peers disagree about the output, weight each attestation down instead of rerunning everything. Idle agents bleed standing, so a parked account loses value while it waits. A trellis of 100 cloned agents needs 100 enclaves, and each one is a device that can be fingerprinted. The river of cheap identities dries up at the hardware line, and the nectar stays with agents that keep signing.
